Synopsis:
If you did not recruit Lae'zel the first time, you recruit her the second time here.
Edge-case: Lae'zel was in the party but failed to be re-added automatically in the party. She can be recruited here.

Cluster Contexts:
- Laezel_Recruitment.json: You recruit Lae'zel to the party. She tells you the only path to a cure of the tadpole in your head is to make your way to a githyanki creche - a nursery and training grounds.
- PLA_GithChokepoint_ConfrontationLaezel.json: Alternate version of the dragon rider scene at chokepoint. Lae'zel is alive and was never recruited. Player can recruit her after this.

Lae'zel approaches the rider to discover where to find the creche. A cure for the tadpole can be found there - or so she believes. However, the knight is under different orders.
- Laezel_Recruitment_Plains.json: This scene is the second‑chance recruitment for Lae'zel — if you missed recruiting her earlier (or she was briefly in your party but failed to be re‑added), she can be recruited here. Off‑screen, Lae'zel senses a psychic connection: she recognizes you as a survivor of the nautiloid and knows you carry a tadpole, and she claims knowledge of a cure and a route back to her queen and Crèche K'liir. A companion (notably Shadowheart) voices immediate distrust, but the player can accept Lae'zel’s offer (often accompanied by a bow) and she will join the party. The sample lines show small phrasing/pronunciation variants, but the essential beats are recognition, an offered alliance/cure, and the recruit decision.
- TUT_LowerDeck_AfterImpFight.json: Companion Lae'zel or (alt gith if Laezel is avatar) will approach the player after spotting the player as she spies on some imps. During the dialogue she has a mindmeld with the player but brushes it aside.
- ShadowHeart_Recruitment_Den.json: The player encounters Shadowheart sheltering in the Druid Grove. When we find her, she seems greatly preoccupied with a strange githyanki artefact. She may join our party after we speak to her, but needs more convincing in the case that gith are present.
Note: Much of this scene plays out in a similar manner to Shadowheart's previous recruitment opportunity closer to the site of the nautiloid crash - we can find her at the druid grove if we advance forwards without recruiting her - she makes her own way to the grove off screen. We may have met her previously, in which case she's suspicious as to why we keep bumping into one another. We may even have been forced to abandon her during our earlier escape from the ship - something she'll recall bitterly. Shadowheart is particularly reluctant to deal with gith players - they were her enemies during her prior secret mission to steal the strange artefact, though the player will not know this yet

context: Lae'zel is a githyanki warrior who either wasn’t recruited earlier or was briefly in the party but failed to be re‑added; this scene is a second chance to bring her on board. Off‑screen, both she and the player share a psychic link from the nautiloid crash: she senses the tadpole in the player’s mind and believes the only cure lies at a githyanki creche (Crèche K'liir) and with her queen. Lae'zel has just confronted a dragon‑rider who is under different orders, and she is furious and determined to find the creche; during the exchange the player briefly experiences her memories/anger. A companion (notably Shadowheart) immediately distrusts Lae'zel, but the player can accept her offer—typically accompanied by a bow—and she will join the party.
